Repo: C:\Users\mariu\ventures\withholding-tax-reclaim. For each of these English Markdown files create a faithful Norwegian bokmål sibling with the same name but `.no.md` extension (e.g. business/business-plan.md -> business/business-plan.no.md): business/business-plan.md, business/market-analysis.md, technical/overview.md. Read each file fully, then Write the translation. Rules: translate prose, headings, table text and list items faithfully and completely (do not summarize or drop content); keep the same structure. Do NOT translate code, inline code, file paths, identifiers, brand/company names, URLs, numbers/currency figures, or the A/B/C grades. Keep relative links working (link targets to other .md files stay as the English paths). Every translated file must begin with this exact banner as its first line, followed by a blank line:
> **Uoffisiell oversettelse (bokmål).** Bekvemmelighetsoversettelse, ikke juridisk/finansiell fagoversettelse. Ved avvik gjelder den engelske originalen. Juridisk og skattemessig innhold er utkast og må gjennomgås av advokat/rådgiver før bruk.
Use LF line endings, UTF-8. Do not modify the English originals, do not touch src/, do not run git commands (no commit). Do not create any other files. When finished, reply with one line listing the files created.
